subject: Request: One-time shelf price override — MarketingPlatform POC
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New logo ask — 50% off request on MP POC / packaging question

Hannah / Marcus,

Quick context: MarketingPlatform has been running a short evaluation with an internal marketing team. After the demo last week, they’ve asked for a 50% off list price for a 6-week POC (Pilot) plus a waiver on the $10k onboarding fee. They’re also unclear about packaging: they want to mix a committed API-call pool + 5 named seats for a dashboard — their usage profile is bursty.

Why this matters: they’re a high-visibility potential customer in adtech, promising a larger expansion (we’re estimating $600k ARR in 12‑18 months if POC converts). Close timing: procurement wants a written commercial offer by EOD Friday to keep the pilot budget this quarter.

Ask: can we approve a one-time, first-year shelf price override to 40% off list (not the 50% they asked for) and waive onboarding? If not, what’s the minimum concession finance will sign off on to keep this in momentum?

Attached: MP-POC-SOW-v1.pdf (scope + usage assumptions), pricing-model-MP.xlsx (revenue math), hubspot-opp-55321.pdf

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call.

Neha
Neha Kapoor | Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New logo ask — 50% off request on MP POC / packaging question

Thanks Neha — good detail. A couple quick clarifying items before I escalate:
- Is the $600k ARR our best-case internal estimate? Please add upside/downsides in one line.
- Confirm whether the POC would be under a purchase order (PO) with payment terms or prepaid credit. Procurement asked specifically about invoicing cadence.
- Can you call out the exact list price line items we’re discounting (API token pricing vs seat pricing vs onboarding)? That helps finance model net ARR.

If we can’t meet their requested timing with a standard discount, I’ll escalate to Marcus for a policy check and to Marissa for sign-off. If you have the HubSpot link, paste it here and I’ll include it in the memo.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 14:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New logo ask — 50% off request on MP POC / packaging question

Hannah / Neha — reviewed the attachments. High level: new logo deals are capped at 30% one-time discount without executive approval. Waiving onboarding is discretionary but pushes ARR hit into implementation expense — we can consider it if the customer signs a minimum committed spend.

Numbers (rough):
- List price for POC (6 weeks): $60k list
- 40% off = $36k revenue first year; 50% off = $30k
- Our conversion model says a >25% chance to expand to enterprise terms if we secure a paid POC with consistent data integration (which seems plausible here).

Recommended escalation memo for Marissa:
- Ask: one-time 40% off + onboarding waived OR 35% off + onboarding waived with a 12-month 100k committed spend.
- Pull-through clause: if they don’t convert to a contract >= $180k within 12 months, discount clawback or apply true-up.
- Finance constraint: revenue must be recognized per delivered services; if onboarding is waived, mark as implementation cost; legal should add language to SOW.

If you want, I’ll draft a short approval memo for Marissa to sign.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin | Head of Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Approval request — one-time shelf price override for MarketingPlatform (Deal RDW-2026-0551-MP)

Marissa,

Sorry to loop you in on short notice. Summary below and attachments included.

Customer: MarketingPlatform (Jordan Lee, VP Product) — procurement@marketingplatform.ai asked for an offer by EOD Friday; they are evaluating 2 vendors.

Commercial request: 40% off list on POC (6-week pilot) + waiver of $10k onboarding. They requested 50% but we’re asking for 40.

Packaging: mix of pre-committed API pool (estimated 1.2M calls in pilot month) + 5 named seats. We propose splitting discount by line: 40% on API pool, 25% on seats.

Risk / Upside: potential ARR $600k if expanded — moderate confidence. If declined, they will likely push timeline 6–8 weeks, which reduces the chance of closing this quarter.

Recommended approval path (as Marcus suggested):
- Approve one-time 40% shelf discount on API pool for first year and waive onboarding IF MarketingPlatform signs a minimum 12-month committed spend of $180k within 30 days of pilot completion; OR
- Approve 35% off + waived onboarding with immediate PO for POC.

Attachments: MP-POC-SOW-v1.pdf; pricing-model-MP.xlsx; hubspot-opp-55321.pdf

Request: Can you confirm approval and any additional contractual conditions (clawback, revenue treatment) so we can send a formal commercial offer to procurement?

Thanks for reviewing on short timeline.

Neha
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 13:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Escalation: Approval request — one-time shelf price override for MarketingPlatform (Deal RDW-2026-0551-MP)

Neha / Hannah / Marcus — I can approve a one-time exception with conditions. Rationale: strategic potential and reasonable chance to expand. Conditions below must be included in the commercial paperwork and verified by Legal/Finance before signing: 

1) Approval: 40% off list on API pool for first year only; seat pricing capped at 25% off. Onboarding fee ($10k) may be waived.
2) Commit requirement: Customer must sign a minimum 12-month commitment that nets at least $180,000 in billed revenue within the first 12 months. If they do not hit $180k, we reserve the right to true-up pricing or invoice the difference retroactively (clawback).
3) Revenue treatment: Finance to classify waived onboarding as implementation expense. Marcus to confirm revenue recognition schedule and booking code.
4) Contractual language: Legal to add a pull-through/true-up clause and milestone verification steps.
5) Approval limited to this one-time exception and to the named account (MarketingPlatform). Any future discounts must follow standard approval flows.

Please proceed to: 1) update the SOW with the commit language and true-up clause, 2) have Legal and Finance sign off on revised SOW and PO, and 3) send the commercial offer to procurement. Marcus, please confirm final wording on revenue classification.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@marketingplatform.ai>, procurement@marketingplatform.ai
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final offer: MarketingPlatform POC (RDW-2026-0551-MP) — 40% off (conditional)

Jordan / Procurement team —

Thanks for the productive conversations this week. Per our internal approvals, Redwood Inference can offer the following commercial terms for the 6-week pilot: 

- Pricing: 40% off list on the API-call pool for the first 12 months; seats priced at 25% off list.
- Onboarding: $10k onboarding fee waived for the pilot.
- Commit & pull-through: MarketingPlatform must sign a 12-month commitment that nets at least $180,000 in billed revenue within 12 months of pilot start. If the $180k threshold is not met, Redwood reserves the right to true-up pricing for the pilot period (clawback).
- Next steps: We will update the SOW and include the pull-through clause. Legal & Finance will validate contract language and revenue treatment. Please provide a PO or DocuSign signature for the updated SOW by EOD Monday to keep the pilot slot prioritized.

HubSpot opp: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/55321
DocuSign (SOW v1 draft): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/placeholder-55321

If these terms work, Procurement can return a signed PO and we’ll schedule kickoff. If you prefer 35% off without the $180k commit, let us know and we’ll route that for a faster (limited) approval.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
